_about: Punch-in / push zoom presets. magnification is a scale factor; focalPoint is 0-1 of frame.

presets.name: Slow Push
presets.description: Move in at a constant speed across the effect interval.

presets.name: Slow Pull
presets.description: Move out at a constant speed across the effect interval.

presets.name: Instant
presets.description: Immediately magnify the picture without an animated transition.

presets.name: Quick In
presets.description: Quick spring zoom in with speed-dependent motion blur.

presets.name: Quick Out
presets.description: Quick spring zoom out with speed-dependent motion blur.

presets.name: Zoom In + Out
presets.description: Spring zoom in, hold, then zoom out; adjust each movement independently.
